title: "Fire effects on forest birds: guilds and species"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
---

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
suppressMessages({library(dplyr); library(readr)})
```

**Design.** Forest zones only (NSW coast + escarpment, East Gippsland). Burnt = site at least 2 km inside the
2019–20 fire extent; unburnt = at least 2 km outside; sites within 2 km of the fire edge are dropped.
Seven forest species in three guilds: ground (Superb Lyrebird, Eastern Yellow Robin) | understorey (shrub +
midstorey) | canopy. Flame Robin is excluded (open-country bird). Eastern Yellow Robin is not in
`detections_long.csv`, so its detections are built from `birdata_raw.csv`: detected = recorded in that survey.

## Load data

```{r load}
guild_of <- c("Menura novaehollandiae" = "ground",
              "Eopsaltria australis" = "ground",
              "Malurus cyaneus" = "understorey",
              "Sericornis frontalis" = "understorey",
              "Acanthiza pusilla" = "understorey",
              "Platycercus elegans" = "canopy",
              "Colluricincla harmonica" = "canopy")
common_of <- c("Menura novaehollandiae" = "Superb Lyrebird", "Eopsaltria australis" = "Eastern Yellow Robin",
               "Malurus cyaneus" = "Superb Fairy-wren",
               "Sericornis frontalis" = "White-browed Scrubwren", "Acanthiza pusilla" = "Brown Thornbill",
               "Platycercus elegans" = "Crimson Rosella", "Colluricincla harmonica" = "Grey Shrike-thrush")
glev <- c("ground", "understorey", "canopy")
# forest zones = NSW coast + escarpment and East Gippsland (not Canberra/ACT, not inland tablelands)
is_forest <- function(lat, lon) !(lat > -35.6 & lon > 148.9 & lon < 149.4) & !(lon < 149.6 & lat > -37)

keep <- function(x) filter(x, is_forest(lat, lon), abs(fire_dist_m) >= 2000)
surveys <- read_csv("data/surveys.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |> keep() |> mutate(survey_id = as.character(survey_id))

# Eastern Yellow Robin: one row per survey, detected = 1 if recorded in that survey
eyr <- read_csv("data/birdata_raw.csv", show_col_types = FALSE, col_select = c(eventID, scientificName)) |>
  filter(grepl("^Eopsaltria australis", gsub("\\s*\\([^)]*\\)", "", scientificName))) |>   # drop subgenus "(...)"
  distinct(survey_id = as.character(eventID)) |>
  mutate(detected = 1L)
eyr_det <- surveys |>
  left_join(eyr, by = "survey_id") |>
  mutate(species = "Eopsaltria australis", detected = coalesce(detected, 0L))

d <- read_csv("data/detections_long.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  keep() |>
  filter(species %in% names(guild_of)) |>
  mutate(survey_id = as.character(survey_id)) |>
  bind_rows(eyr_det) |>
  mutate(after  = as.integer(period == "after"),
         burnt  = as.integer(fire_dist_m < 0),       # fire_dist_m: signed distance to fire edge, negative = inside
         season = factor(season, levels = c("summer", "autumn", "winter", "spring")),
         site = factor(site), species = factor(species), grp = factor(guild_of[as.character(species)], glev))

d |>
  mutate(Species = common_of[as.character(species)], Guild = grp,
         cell = paste(ifelse(burnt == 1, "Burnt", "Unburnt"), period)) |>
  group_by(Guild, Species, cell) |>
  summarise(n = sprintf("%d / %d", sum(detected), n()), .groups = "drop") |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = cell, values_from = n) |>
  select(Guild, Species, `Burnt before`, `Burnt after`, `Unburnt before`, `Unburnt after`) |>
  arrange(Guild) |>
  knitr::kable()
```

## Habitat lost to fire (Levins model)

Binomial GLMM (logit link) with one fire effect δ per guild (the burnt × after interaction); each species has its
own baseline, before/after change, burnt/unburnt difference and season effect; random intercepts for site and
site × species. In Levins' model with habitat destruction, P = 1 − v − e/c, so the share of patches lost to fire is
v = P without fire − P with fire, both predicted for burnt sites after the fire. The unburnt sites give e/c = 1 − P*.

```{r levins}
library(lme4)
ctrl <- glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 1e5))
base <- "detected ~ species * after + species * burnt + species:season + (1 | site) + (1 | site:species)"
m2 <- glmer(as.formula(paste(base, "+ grp:burnt:after")), d, binomial, control = ctrl, nAGQ = 0)

# coefficient name for guild g × burnt × after (any order of the parts)
gterm <- sapply(glev, function(g) {
  nms <- names(fixef(m2))
  nms[vapply(strsplit(nms, ":"), function(x) length(x) == 3 && setequal(x, c(paste0("grp", g), "burnt", "after")), TRUE)]
})
B <- fixef(m2); V <- as.matrix(vcov(m2))
ba <- d$burnt == 1 & d$after == 1
eta <- predict(m2, re.form = NA)[ba]               # linear predictor, burnt sites after the fire
set.seed(1)
draws <- MASS::mvrnorm(2000, B[gterm], V[gterm, gterm])   # uncertainty in the guild δ

# P* = 1 - e/c (no fire); fire adds v:  P = 1 - v - e/c
#   buffer_used = v / P*             share of the way to the extinction threshold (v = P*)
#   c_needed    = (e/c) / (e/c - v)  factor by which colonisation must rise to restore P*
#   e_needed    = 1 - v / (e/c)      factor by which local extinction must fall to restore P*
mgmt_one <- function(g, delta) {
  i <- d$grp[ba] == g
  Pstar <- mean(plogis(eta[i] - B[[gterm[[g]]]]))
  v <- Pstar - mean(plogis(eta[i] - B[[gterm[[g]]]] + delta))
  ec <- 1 - Pstar
  c(Pstar = Pstar, v = v, e_over_c = ec, buffer_used = v / Pstar, c_needed = ec / (ec - v), e_needed = 1 - v / ec)
}
mgmt <- bind_rows(lapply(glev, function(g) {
  est  <- mgmt_one(g, B[[gterm[[g]]]])
  sims <- t(apply(draws, 1, function(x) mgmt_one(g, x[[gterm[[g]]]])))
  data.frame(guild = g, quantity = names(est), est = est,
             lo = apply(sims, 2, quantile, 0.025), hi = apply(sims, 2, quantile, 0.975))
}))
knitr::kable(mgmt, digits = 3, row.names = FALSE)
```


## Fire effects: overall, by guild, and within guilds

Four nested models: no fire effect (m0), one common δ (m1), one δ per guild (m2), one δ per species (m3).
H0 = m1 vs m0, H1 = m2 vs m1, H2 = m3 vs m2 (likelihood-ratio tests). δ is the burnt × after interaction (log-odds).

```{r models}
library(lme4)
ctrl <- glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 1e5))
base <- "detected ~ species * after + species * burnt + species:season + (1 | site) + (1 | site:species)"
fit  <- function(f) glmer(as.formula(f), d, binomial, control = ctrl, nAGQ = 0)
m0 <- fit(base)                                   # no fire effect
m1 <- fit(paste(base, "+ burnt:after"))           # one δ             (H0: m1 vs m0)
m2 <- fit(paste(base, "+ grp:burnt:after"))       # one δ per guild   (H1: m2 vs m1)
m3 <- fit(paste(base, "+ species:burnt:after"))   # one δ per species (H2: m3 vs m2)
anova(m0, m1, m2, m3)
lrt  <- function(a, b) { t <- anova(a, b); list(chisq = t$Chisq[2], df = t$Df[2], p = t$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2]) }
lrts <- list(H0 = lrt(m0, m1), H1 = lrt(m1, m2), H2 = lrt(m2, m3))
```

```{r estimates}
# names of the burnt × after coefficients, keyed by guild / species level
baci_terms <- function(nms, prefix) {
  parts <- strsplit(nms, ":")
  keep <- vapply(parts, function(x) length(x) == 3 && all(c("burnt", "after") %in% x) &&
                   any(startsWith(x, prefix)), logical(1))
  lev <- vapply(parts[keep], function(x) sub(paste0("^", prefix), "", x[startsWith(x, prefix)]), "")
  setNames(nms[keep], lev)
}
ci <- function(label, est, se) data.frame(label = label, est = est, lo = est - 1.96 * se, hi = est + 1.96 * se,
                                          p = 2 * pnorm(-abs(est / se)))
# difference between two coefficients, SE from the covariance matrix
diff_ci <- function(m, a, b, label) {
  B <- fixef(m); V <- as.matrix(vcov(m))
  ci(label, unname(B[a] - B[b]), sqrt(V[a, a] + V[b, b] - 2 * V[a, b]))
}

B1 <- fixef(m1); ba1 <- names(B1)[vapply(strsplit(names(B1), ":"), function(x) setequal(x, c("burnt", "after")), TRUE)]
common <- ci("All 7 species", unname(B1[ba1]), sqrt(diag(as.matrix(vcov(m1))))[[ba1]])

gi <- baci_terms(names(fixef(m2)), "grp"); se2 <- sqrt(diag(as.matrix(vcov(m2))))
guild <- bind_rows(lapply(glev, function(g) ci(g, unname(fixef(m2)[gi[[g]]]), unname(se2[gi[[g]]]))))
contr <- bind_rows(diff_ci(m2, gi[["understorey"]], gi[["canopy"]], "understorey − canopy"),
                   diff_ci(m2, gi[["understorey"]], gi[["ground"]], "understorey − ground"),
                   diff_ci(m2, gi[["ground"]],      gi[["canopy"]], "ground − canopy")) |>
  mutate(p_holm = p.adjust(p, "holm"))

si <- baci_terms(names(fixef(m3)), "species")
within <- bind_rows(lapply(glev, function(g) {      # every pair of species in the same guild
  s <- names(guild_of)[guild_of == g]
  if (length(s) < 2) return(NULL)
  bind_rows(apply(combn(s, 2), 2, function(pr)
    diff_ci(m3, si[[pr[1]]], si[[pr[2]]], paste(common_of[pr[1]], "−", common_of[pr[2]])) |> mutate(grp = g)))
})) |> mutate(p_holm = p.adjust(p, "holm"))

knitr::kable(bind_rows(common, guild, select(contr, -p_holm), select(within, -grp, -p_holm)), digits = 3)
```

Points are estimates on the log-odds scale with 95% Wald confidence intervals; the dashed line marks no effect.
δ < 0 means detection declined more at burnt than at unburnt sites after the fire. All four figures share the same x-axis.
P values are Wald tests, except in (a), where P is the likelihood-ratio test of H0. P (Holm) is adjusted within each figure.

```{r figure-setup}
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
gcol <- c(ground = "#8C6D31", understorey = "#C0392B", canopy = "#1F3A5F", all = "grey15")
fmt_ci <- function(e, l, h) gsub("-", "\u2212", sprintf("%.2f (%.2f, %.2f)", e, l, h))
fmt_p  <- function(p) ifelse(p < 0.001, "< 0.001", sprintf("%.3f", p))
lrt_txt <- function(x) sprintf("Likelihood-ratio test: \u03c7\u00b2(%d) = %.2f, P = %s", x$df, x$chisq, fmt_p(x$p))
# one x-axis for all four figures, wide enough for every interval
xl <- c(floor(min(common$lo, guild$lo, contr$lo, within$lo) * 2) / 2,
        ceiling(max(common$hi, guild$hi, contr$hi, within$hi) * 2) / 2)
theme_fp <- theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(colour = "black"), axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11), plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9, colour = "grey25"))

# forest plot (left) + table of statistics (right); `cols` = named list, header -> one string per row
# facet = TRUE splits the rows into guild panels (canopy on top) with the guild named on the left
forest <- function(df, cols, xlab, title, subtitle = NULL, facet = FALSE, widths = c(1.5, 1)) {
  df <- mutate(df, label = factor(label, rev(unique(label))))
  if (facet) df <- mutate(df, grp = factor(grp, rev(glev), tools::toTitleCase(rev(glev))))
  p1 <- ggplot(df, aes(est, label, colour = col)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2, colour = "grey55", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = lo, xmax = hi), size = 0.35, linewidth = 0.6) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = gcol, guide = "none") +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = xl, breaks = seq(ceiling(xl[1]), floor(xl[2]), 1),
                       labels = function(x) gsub("-", "\u2212", x)) +
    labs(x = xlab, y = NULL) + theme_fp
  xpos <- c(0, 0.62, 0.8)[seq_along(cols)]
  tab <- bind_rows(lapply(seq_along(cols), function(i)
    data.frame(select(df, any_of(c("label", "grp"))), x = xpos[i], txt = cols[[i]])))
  p2 <- ggplot(tab, aes(x, label, label = txt)) +
    geom_text(hjust = 0, size = 6) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), breaks = xpos, labels = names(cols), position = "top", expand = c(0, 0)) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") + theme_void(base_size = 10) +
    theme(axis.text.x.top = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0, size = 20, margin = margin(b = 4)))
  if (facet) {
    p1 <- p1 + facet_grid(grp ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y", switch = "y") +
      theme(strip.placement = "outside", strip.background = element_blank(),
            strip.text.y.left = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 1, face = "bold"), panel.spacing.y = unit(8, "pt"))
    p2 <- p2 + facet_grid(grp ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
      theme(strip.text = element_blank(), panel.spacing.y = unit(8, "pt"))
  }
  p1 + p2 + plot_layout(widths = widths) + plot_annotation(title = title, subtitle = subtitle, theme = theme_fp)
}
```

```{r fig-h0, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 1.8, fig.cap = "Figure 1. Common fire effect across all seven species (H0)."}
forest(mutate(common, col = "all"),
       list("P" = fmt_p(lrts$H0$p)),
       xlab = "Fire effect",
       title = "(a) Overall fire effect") +
  plot_annotation(theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold")))
```

```{r fig-h1, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 2.4, fig.cap = "Figure 2. Fire effect for each guild (H1)."}
g <- mutate(guild, col = label, label = tools::toTitleCase(label))
g <- g[match(c("canopy", "understorey", "ground"), g$col), ]   # top to bottom
p <- forest(g,
            list("P" = fmt_p(g$p)),
            xlab = "Fire effect across guilds",
            title = "(b) Fire effect by guild") +
  plot_annotation(theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold")))
p[[1]] <- p[[1]] + theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 15, colour = "black"))
p
```

```{r fig-h1-contrasts, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 2.4, fig.cap = "Figure 3. Pairwise differences in fire effect between guilds (H1)."}
k <- mutate(contr, col = "all", label = sub("^(\\w)", "\\U\\1", label, perl = TRUE))
forest(k, list("\u0394\u03b4 (95% CI)" = fmt_ci(k$est, k$lo, k$hi), "P" = fmt_p(k$p), "P (Holm)" = fmt_p(k$p_holm)),
       xlab = "Difference in fire effect, \u0394\u03b4 (log odds ratio)",
       title = "(c) Guild vs guild", subtitle = "Negative = the first guild declined more")
```

```{r fig-h2, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 3.4, fig.cap = "Figure 4. Pairwise differences in fire effect between species within the same guild (H2)."}
wp <- mutate(within, col = grp)
p <- forest(wp, list("P" = fmt_p(wp$p)),
            xlab = "Difference in fire effect",
            title = "(c) Species vs species within each guild",
            facet = TRUE, widths = c(1, 1.15)) +
  plot_annotation(theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold")))
p[[1]] <- p[[1]] + theme(strip.text.y.left = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold", angle = 0, hjust = 1))
p
```



```{r habitat-figure, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 3.4}
gcol <- c(ground = "#8C6D31", understorey = "#C0392B", canopy = "#1F3A5F")
lab  <- function(x) tools::toTitleCase(x)
fmt  <- function(x, d = 2) gsub("-", "\u2212", formatC(x, format = "f", digits = d))
theme_fp <- theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(colour = "black"), axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11), plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9, colour = "grey25"))

w <- tidyr::pivot_wider(mgmt, id_cols = guild, names_from = quantity, values_from = c(est, lo, hi)) |>
  mutate(guild = factor(lab(guild), lab(glev)))                       # first level at the bottom: canopy on top
bars <- bind_rows(transmute(w, guild, part = "Occupied after fire", value = est_Pstar - pmax(est_v, 0)),
                  transmute(w, guild, part = "Lost to fire (v)",    value = pmax(est_v, 0))) |>
  mutate(part = factor(part, c("Lost to fire (v)", "Occupied after fire")),
         fillkey = ifelse(part == "Lost to fire (v)", "lost", tolower(as.character(guild))))

p1 <- ggplot(bars, aes(value, guild)) +
  geom_col(aes(fill = fillkey, group = part), width = 0.6, colour = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(gcol, lost = "grey80"), guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 0.45), breaks = seq(0, 0.4, 0.1), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = "Proportion of surveys with a detection, P", y = NULL) +
  theme_fp + theme(axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15, colour = "black"))

cols <- list("Lost" = paste0(fmt(pmax(100 * w$est_buffer_used, 0), 0), "%"))
xpos <- 0
tab <- bind_rows(lapply(seq_along(cols), function(i) data.frame(guild = w$guild, x = xpos[i], txt = cols[[i]])))
p2 <- ggplot(tab, aes(x, guild, label = txt)) +
  geom_text(hjust = 0, size = 6) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), breaks = xpos, labels = names(cols), position = "top", expand = c(0, 0)) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") + theme_void(base_size = 10) +
  theme(axis.text.x.top = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0, size = 15, margin = margin(b = 4)))

(p1 + p2 + plot_layout(widths = c(3, 1))) +
  plot_annotation(title = "Habitat lost to fire, by guild",
                  theme = theme_fp + theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
                                           plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0, size = 8, colour = "grey30")))
```
